scope: Official schema interpretation and metadata consistency before execution; CIKs/pair definition/request budget/financial gates unchanged.

annual_end_screen.meaning: Metadata end-date consistency only, not proof of complete financial periods or historic share-class identity. Original10-K ordering/adjacent distinct periods and header checks still required; no tuning after intake.

pagination: Use direct neighboring ranges from the same complete catalog including current recent metadata coverage. A natural-date gap alone is not a missing filing. Loaded response range/record consistency and exclusion of every unread range that could intervene in required annual ordering remain necessary. No extra page, alternative pair or issuer.
PAC: Official PDS states PAC changes headers/deletion/form/document type, not document text. Separate metadata_version_status from body_first_vintage_status; a late change date proves neither body mutation nor first-vintage integrity.
clock: Reviewed official PDS labels acceptance time EST; no unsupported assumption of historical DST/NY conversion or JSON-clock semantic equivalence. Preserve raw schemas; unresolved/conflicting times remain unknown and cannot trigger candidate reselection.
